description: CPP-only ConfigBase semantic probes for indexed relative values and the coPercent ratio downcast regression.

mutants.test_filter: ConfigBase indexed getters use the matching travel speed slot
mutants.description: Use the matching travel-speed ratio slot for indexed percentages; slot zero gives the wrong second-slot result.

mutants.test_filter: ConfigBase resolves a registered coPercent ratio against layer height
mutants.description: Restore the measured invalid downcast from coPercent to ConfigOptionFloatOrPercent. The two generated ironing-flow settings must each fail the ordinary expected-value assertion (50 instead of 0.1 for a 50% ratio over layer height 0.2).
